newsitem.title: MAURITIUS: Sugar, Air Mauritius support Mauritius bourse.
newsitem.headline: Sugar, Air Mauritius support Mauritius bourse.

text.p: The Mauritius bourse index Semdex rose by O.59 points on Monday to 389.90 after a surge in sugar company Mon Tresor Mon Desert (MTMD) and national carrier Air Mauritius, bourse officials said.
Turnover rose to 23.80 million rupees on 564,238 shares from 17.90 million rupees on 621,712 shares on last Friday.
MTMD climbed 1.70 to 42 rupees on 70,000 shares, Harel Freres was stable at 52 on 300 shares. The national carrier Air Mauritius was 60 cents higher to 40 on 25,000 shares.

In the hotel sector, Grand Baie Hotel gained 50 cents to 45.50 rupees on 20,000 shares, New Mauritius Hotels was unchanged to 36 rupees on 200,000 shares and Sun Resorts was stable at 49 rupees on 783 shares.

Commerce-based Shell gained 10 cents to 20.10 rupees on 300 shares. Conglomerates Ireland Blyth Ltd was 40 cents higher to 15.70 rupees on 11,400 shares and Rogers lost 3.0 to 110.00 on 65,140 shares.

In the banking and insurance sector, the Swan rose 20 cents to 45.70 on 2,000 shares, British American Insurance was stable to 8.45 rupees on 2,000 shares, the Mauritius Commercial Bank was unchanged to 89 on 16,479 shares and the State Bank of Mauritius was stable at 13 on 33,400 shares.
